_provenance.purpose: Grounded alias table so an Infrastructure extinction pass (energy-extinction.js pattern) does not falsely retire activations. activeTriggers is built from pulse condition-codes (e.g. grid_stress) + active diagnosis ids (energy-telemetry-adapter.js L48-53 pattern). In Infrastructure NEITHER the condition-codes NOR the active diagnosis ids textually equal any activation.diagnosticTrigger: activation triggers are FREE-TEXT phrases ('Grid frequency instability'), condition-codes are tokens ('grid_stress'), and the active diagnosis ids are brain keys ('GRID_DEGRADATION'). So BOTH maps below are strictly required (unlike Finance, where the diagnosis-id self-matched the trigger).
_provenance.derivationChain: condition-code --(infrastructure-pulse-engine.js inline classify, L179-233)--> evidence family --(EVIDENCE_CONTRACTS requiredFamilies, OR-semantics, L246-252)--> BRAIN diagnosis id (GRID_DEGRADATION / MAINTENANCE_DEFICIT / CYBER_PHYSICAL_ATTACK) --(domain-identity.js INFRA_PORTAL_TO_BRAIN, REVERSED)--> portal ISSUE id (GRID_FAILURE ...) --(infrastructure.json issues[]._authored circuit; adapter uses is._authored||is.circuits)--> circuit nodeIds --(those nodeIds are activations)--> free-text diagnosticTriggers. The INFRA_PORTAL_TO_BRAIN reverse hop is the EXTRA link Infrastructure needs that Finance did not: in Finance diagnosis id === issue id, but in Infrastructure the brain-diagnosis vocabulary (GRID_DEGRADATION) is DISJOINT from the portal-issue vocabulary (GRID_FAILURE) and infrastructure-brain.js L459-465 re-resolves them through INFRA_PORTAL_TO_BRAIN at runtime.
_provenance.foldRule: A condition-code is folded into a diagnosis only when the condition emits an evidence family that appears in that diagnosis's requiredFamilies (matching the actual code gate, requiredFamilies with OR-semantics, NOT primaryIndicators), AND that diagnosis's brain-key has at least one portal issue behind it via INFRA_PORTAL_TO_BRAIN (i.e. a real _authored circuit exists to expand). A condition whose only reachable diagnosis has NO portal issue (SUPPLY_CHAIN_BOTTLENECK, CAPACITY_OVERLOAD, FUNDING_COLLAPSE) is a dead-end and is listed under unmapped, NOT folded (bias against over-marking).
_provenance.discipline: No link invented. Conditions with no defensible chain to an _authored circuit are under unmapped. Trigger strings copied verbatim from infrastructure.json; extinction matching is case-insensitive substring (energy-extinction.js L22,L29).
_provenance.heterogeneityVsEnergyAndFinance: DIFFERENT structure on four axes. (1) TWO DISJOINT DIAGNOSIS VOCABULARIES: the pulse-engine / brain diagnoses (GRID_DEGRADATION, MAINTENANCE_DEFICIT, CYBER_PHYSICAL_ATTACK, SUPPLY_CHAIN_BOTTLENECK, CAPACITY_OVERLOAD, FUNDING_COLLAPSE) are NOT the portal issue ids (GRID_FAILURE, BRIDGE_COLLAPSE, WATER_CRISIS, TELECOM_OUTAGE, TRANSIT_BREAKDOWN). They are bridged only by domain-identity.js INFRA_PORTAL_TO_BRAIN; infrastructure-brain.js L459-462 explicitly comments on this load-order hazard. (2) MANY-TO-ONE COLLAPSE: three portal issues (BRIDGE_COLLAPSE, WATER_CRISIS, TRANSIT_BREAKDOWN) all map to the single brain key MAINTENANCE_DEFICIT, so that one diagnosis expands to a 12-node union. (3) HALF THE DIAGNOSIS SURFACE IS A DEAD-END: SUPPLY_CHAIN_BOTTLENECK, CAPACITY_OVERLOAD and FUNDING_COLLAPSE (and TRANSPORTATION_DISRUPTION) are reachable by condition-codes but NO portal issue maps to them, so ~15 condition-codes classify to a diagnosis with no _authored circuit and cannot be grounded (Finance had 1 dead-end family, macro_shock; Infrastructure has a whole cluster plus macro_shock). (4) ORPHAN COUNT: Energy 1, Finance 3, Infrastructure 10 — because Infrastructure carries 32 activations (more than any other domain) but only 15 are authored into an issue circuit.

MAINTENANCE_DEFICIT.basis: MANY-TO-ONE: INFRA_PORTAL_TO_BRAIN maps THREE portal issues (BRIDGE_COLLAPSE, WATER_CRISIS, TRANSIT_BREAKDOWN) to the single brain key MAINTENANCE_DEFICIT. When active, the adapter marks the _authored circuit nodes of ALL THREE issues active, so the alias is the 12-node union of their _authored circuits and the union of those activations' free-text triggers. This is the largest expansion in the table and the key structural difference from Finance (where each diagnosis had exactly one issue).

CYBER_PHYSICAL_ATTACK.basis: Brain diagnosis CYBER_PHYSICAL_ATTACK === INFRA_PORTAL_TO_BRAIN['TELECOM_OUTAGE']. When active, the adapter marks issues['TELECOM_OUTAGE']._authored [LANG, FPN, CeA, dlPFC, STRI] active. NOTE the semantic seam: the portal frames TELECOM_OUTAGE as a telecom/digital failure, while the brain key is CYBER_PHYSICAL_ATTACK — the authoring pass equated telecom/digital infrastructure loss with cyber-physical compromise (domain-identity.js L123 comment 'digital/telecom infra -> cyber-physical').
